title: Unknown singular geometry defeats spectrum-only archive pricing
status_detail: The reduction to N36's model is exact. The numerical lower bound and matching N31/N30 construction remain source-derived candidate results; their full proof packages were not present in the local checkout and were not independently validated here.

claim.known_geometry: For X_i=r_i v_i+Z_i, sum(v_i^2)<=1, known r_i in [0,1], whitened standard Gaussian noise, and whole-law TV error eps, inherited N31 candidate gives 0.5*S_r(100 eps)<=log2(D_q)<=log2(D_cl)<=0.5*S_r(eps)+14*N_r(eps).
claim.unknown_geometry_family: For d-by-d A_i=r e_i e_1^T, i=1,...,d, all have the same rank-one singular spectrum. Encoder is not told i; after storage one coordinate query i arrives and its own POVM must reproduce N(+/-r,1) for theta=+/-e_1. For 128 eps<=r<=1, inherited N36 candidate gives ln(D)>=(d/2)ln(r/eps)-(5/4+ln 2)d.
claim.known_index_control: If i is supplied before encoding, scalar N30 candidate has log2(D)=0.5 log2(r/eps)+O(1) for eps<r<=1.
claim.no_tail_envelope: If the unknown spectrum class contains arbitrarily many active singular values equal to one, no finite D is uniform at fixed eps<1/128, by the same growing-dimensional lower bound.

cost_contract.archive: B=log2(D), D=sum_j d_j for every input-dependent hybrid direct-sum register
cost_contract.quantum: unassisted; no correlated side information or free entangled reference; independent seed only if dimension bound holds at every seed
cost_contract.query: exactly one coordinate-specific POVM after storage; no joint-output premise; the query index costs ceil(log2 d) communicated bits in an end-to-end protocol
cost_contract.acquisition: operator queries, model transcript bits, calibration precision, compilation and decode time reported separately; a retained K-way classical model transcript multiplies D by K
cost_contract.finite_precision: ideal continuous-TV theorem distinguished from atomic finite-output TV, which equals one against a non-atomic Gaussian target

equal_information_baseline: Same observation family, same eps, same output target. Classical product positive-hat archive costs 0.5*d*log2(r/eps)+O(d) bits; this matches the quantum lower in leading precision coefficient. With known i, the matching scalar classical archive costs 0.5*log2(r/eps)+O(1).
falsifier: An independently checked hybrid quantum archive with o(d log(r/eps)) bits under the exact hidden-direction / later-query contract, or a flaw in the N36 proper-score/entropy tensorization step, refutes the claimed dimension penalty.
next_gate: Independently reconstruct N36's increasing finite-partition/strong-subadditivity argument and N31's positive-kernel TV upper; then implement a rational calibration-to-code pipeline with a certified operator norm and effective tail witness.
not_claimed: optimal acquisition sample complexity for unknown singular vectors
minimax parameter-estimation risk for an unbounded inverse loss
